subject: POC observability plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: POC observability plan & success criteria

Hi Alex / Priya 

Great conversation today  thanks for walking through the integration surface and the initial evaluation goals. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed observability plan for the 4-week POC and confirm success criteria and ownership so we can lock timelines.

High-level POC goals (confirmed on call):
- Validate inference latency and stability under your peak test traffic (target: p95 < 250ms for 1k req/min)
- Measure unit cost with Redwood batching/kv-cache enabled (target: <= $0.005 per generated token)
- Confirm data controls / auditability for PCI-adjacent flows

Proposed observability scope (what Redwood will provide + what we need from FintechX):
1) Dashboards (Redwood Console + shared Grafana panel)
  - Latency by model and route (p50/p95/p99), token throughput, request rate
  - Error rate and top error classes (timeout, model load errors)
  - Cost metrics: tokens generated, billed units, estimated USD per hour
2) Tracing
  - End-to-end trace on request path: client -> edge -> model -> response
  - Span tags for request id, model version, route, tenant id
3) Logs & exports
  - Request/response metadata (no sensitive PII payloads) shipped to your S3 (or our secure export) for retention and audit
  - Audit logs for admin actions and model rollouts
4) Metrics to monitor during POC
  - p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, throughput, cold-start frequency, kv-cache hit rate
  - Token cost per request, average tokens per response

Ownership and next steps (proposed):
- FintechX: provide test datasets, SSO account for test cluster, and S3 bucket for log export (owner: Alex)
- Redwood: instrument dashboards, tracing, and export; share a checklist and SLA draft (owner: Marissa)
- Integration lead (Redwood): Jordan to be primary contact for instrumentation work
- Weekly check-ins: Thurs 11am PT starting Oct 22

Attachments: POC_Observability_Checklist.xlsx (checklist + required creds), redwood-poc-sla-draft.pdf (draft terms)

Can you confirm these items and the success criteria above? If that looks good I will assign ownership internally and schedule the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechx.com>

Subject: Re: POC observability plan & success criteria

Thanks Marissa  this captures everything from the call. A few clarifications and asks from our side: 

- Success criteria: we agree on latency targets and cost targets, but can we add model output quality checks? We'll run a set of 300 prompts and expect >= 92% accuracy on the labeled set (owner: Priya).
- Logs: we prefer the S3 export. Can Redwood redact any user PII at export time? If not, we will provide a sanitized test dataset.
- Security/compliance: we require access to audit logs and an exported SOC 2 summary during the POC; procurement looped in for the paperwork.
- Timeline: we are targeting the POC kickoff the week of Oct 25; procurement has a one-week review window.

We'll review the checklist and the SLA draft and circle back with any redlines. For SSO access, I will send the invite list to Jordan and Marissa by tomorrow.

Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Platform, FintechX

Thanks  all requested items look reasonable. Quick responses below:
- Model quality: yes, we can run the evaluation harness on your labeled set and populate a quality dashboard (we will report accuracy, F1 where applicable).
- PII redaction: Redwood can apply automated redaction on exported logs for common PII patterns (emails, SSNs) but we recommend a sanitized test set for the main evaluation  we'll include redaction steps in the checklist.
- SOC2 summary: attaching redwood-poc-sla-draft.pdf  we'll provide our SOC 2 summary and any additional evidence requested via secure share once procurement confirms.
- Timeline: Jordan is copied  Jordan, can you confirm availability for a kickoff the week of Oct 25 and whether you need FintechX to open any ports or provide IP allowlist entries?

Marissa
